title: The tensor-formula pullback of modules is left adjoint to pushforward
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with ring map $g^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y\to g_*\mathcal O_X$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], its inverse image sheaf $g^{-1}\mathcal G$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] has the $g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$-module structure induced from the action on $\mathcal G$. Set $P_g\mathcal G=\mathcal O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}g^{-1}\mathcal G$ using the sheaf tensor product and change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. The assignment $P_g$ extends to a functor on module sheaves, acting on a morphism $u:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$ by $\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal O_X}\otimes g^{-1}u$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal F$, define $g_*\mathcal F$ on opens $V\subseteq Y$ by $(g_*\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(g^{-1}V)$, with its $\mathcal O_Y(V)$-action restricted along $g^\sharp_V$. Then the natural map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(P_g\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_Y}(\mathcal G,g_*\mathcal F)$ obtained by tensor/restriction of scalars and inverse-image/direct-image adjunction is a bijection, natural in both modules. Consequently $P_g$ is left adjoint to $g_*$.
